title: Just Calculator UI
description: Added a calculator page to calculate recipe materials.
body:
### **What can it do?**

It helps players quickly calculate required materials for bulk crafting. It provides persistent on-screen material lists, detects items in shulker boxes, supports multiple preset slots and display styles, integrates with JEI to view recipes, and allows key binding customization.

### **How to use it?**

Use a configurable key (default: U) to open the calculator, view a recipe in JEI, and click '+' to auto-import the required materials into the list.

_Feel free to include this mod in any modpack — I'd greatly appreciate it. Report any issues on GitHub._
